title: Delinquency Reserve on Fleet Credit Refunds for Recent Kestrel Retail Late Charges — Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease
content:
# Cross-Product Credit Bulletin — Delinquency Reserve on Fleet Credit Refunds

**Rule.** For the refund of a credit balance on a turned-in unit of the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the refund delinquency reserve is $1,000 where two or more late charges were posted on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts within the last 6 whole months, $500 where exactly one was, and nothing where none was.

**Records read.** The late charges posted on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts and their posting dates. A late charge falls within the last 6 whole months when fewer than 6 whole months separate its posting date from today, a whole month being one fewer than the calendar months between the two dates where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's.

| Retail late charges on the business's Kestrel New Vehicle Retail Installment Sale Contracts within the last 6 whole months | Refund delinquency reserve |
|---|---|
| two or more | $1,000 (1000) |
| exactly one | $500 (500) |
| none | nothing |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. Three retail late charges posted 1, 3 and 8 whole months ago: two fall within the window, $1,000.
2. One retail late charge posted 4 whole months ago: $500.
3. One posted on the 15th of a month, today being the 15th of the month six months later: 6 whole months separate them, outside the window, nothing.
4. Today being the 14th of that month: 5 whole months, within the window, $500.
